summary: Product-09 result arithmetic is internally consistent, but claim fidelity, tool isolation, label provenance, cleanup evidence, and run-to-code/input binding are insufficient for an audit-grade Product-10 control.

A_ground_truth_provenance.reason: Answer GT is dataset-backed, but turn labels are a Qwen non-human-adjudicated proxy and memory-only execution is not enforced.

B_score_normalization.reason: No self-normalization; exact is normalized EM and all_answer_turn_recall is case completion rather than micro recall.

C_result_and_claim_fidelity.reason: Results exist and recompute, but restart/formal-access/cleanup claims and run provenance do not match the evidence.

D_dead_code_and_output_reachability.reason: Metrics execute, but full traces, non-memory events, failures, stderr/stdout tails, and scorer identity are omitted.

E_scope.reason: Two synthetic lifecycle successes and four opened-development cases do not support broad, causal, robust, or production claims.

F_evaluation_type.reason: The package mixes real dataset answer GT, model-assisted turn proxy, and synthetic integration smoke.

evaluation_families.name: product09_lifecycle
evaluation_families.claim_ceiling: bounded local synthetic integration smoke with prompt-forced tool use

evaluation_families.name: product09_host_guidance
evaluation_families.claim_ceiling: single recorded regression, no causal claim

action_items: Rerun sealed A0 before any Product-10 quantitative comparison.
Bind Product tree/lock, Lab runner, all inputs, command, timestamp, exact Codex identity/config, full redacted trace, and checked cleanup receipt.
Enforce memory-only tool and filesystem isolation and retain failed, incomplete, and extra tool events.
Report normalized EM, case-completion, and micro turn coverage separately; label Qwen turn annotations as proxy.
Separate formal file access from formal case scoring.
Keep Product-10 X0-X4 unstarted until effect authorization.
